description: Na₃B₅O₈S crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.90 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one S and six O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 2.80 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.58-2.90 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three equivalent S and two O atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.77-2.96 Å. There is one shorter (2.48 Å) and one longer (2.61 Å) Na-O bond length. There are five inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.36-1.41 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.51 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one S and two O atoms. The B-S bond length is 1.83 Å. There is one shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.40 Å) B-O bond length. In the fifth B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.45-1.51 Å. S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one B atom. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to three Na and two B atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two Na and two B atoms.
